Container Office in Kolkata

Kolkata is eastern India's freight and logistics gateway. The Port of Kolkata and the Haldia dock complex move cargo for the whole eastern region; the Dankuni and Howrah industrial belts and the Taratala corridor handle warehousing, engineering, and distribution. Wherever there is a port yard, a warehouse, or a freight depot, there is a need for a workspace on the ground â€” a dispatch supervisor's cabin, a security post at the gate, a site office for a construction or contractor team.

SAMAN manufactures steel container offices and supplies them across Kolkata. We build at our facility in Greater Noida and dispatch to your port, yard, or industrial site. And because Kolkata's monsoon is heavy and the humidity is constant, we seal and treat the unit for those conditions before it leaves the factory â€” so it stays dry and sound through a Bengal monsoon, not just a dry-season showroom unit.

Explore the container office lineup and specifications or call us to discuss your requirement.

Who Buys a Container Office in Kolkata

A container office is a finished steel workspace â€” built from a refabricated shipping container or a new container-style steel frame â€” that arrives wired, insulated, and ready to use. No civil construction, no waiting. In Kolkata's port and logistics economy the buyers are clear:

Port and dock operators at Kolkata Port, Haldia, and the river-side cargo handling areas use container offices as dispatch supervision cabins and gate security posts. A steel unit that already looks and works like a shipping container fits naturally into a port-yard environment.

Warehouse and logistics operators across the Dankuni, Howrah, and Taratala belts place container offices at warehouse entries for gate control and supervisor workspace. A container portable office for site teams suits operations that reorganise their yard layout periodically.

Freight and distribution contractors use them as temporary coordination offices at transit and consolidation points.

Construction and EPC contractors building across the Kolkata metropolitan region need a durable site office and a security cabin that holds up through the monsoon.

Kolkata's Industrial and Port Zones â€” Where We Deliver

Telling us your delivery zone lets us plan the route and quote accurate freight. We deliver across the Kolkata region, including:

Taratala industrial corridor (PIN 700088): The south Kolkata industrial and logistics belt near the port, dense with engineering, distribution, and manufacturing units. Container offices here serve as factory cabins, warehouse offices, and security posts.

Kolkata Port and Haldia dock area: The cargo-handling belt along the Hooghly. Port yards, freight depots, and dock operations use container offices for supervision and gate control.

Dankuni industrial and logistics belt: The major warehousing and freight hub on the western approach to Kolkata. New warehouse construction here drives demand for site and security offices.

Howrah industrial belt: The long-established engineering and manufacturing zone across the river. Container offices serve factory and contractor needs across this dense belt.

Outside these zones, we deliver to construction, port, and industrial sites across the Kolkata metropolitan region wherever a crane or forklift can place the unit.

Sizes and Specifications â€” Sealed for the Bengal Monsoon

Built to stay dry and sound on a Kolkata port or industrial site through the monsoon.

Structure: Refabricated ISO shipping container OR new IS 2062 grade steel frame, anti-rust treated and painted
Monsoon sealing: Sealed roof overlaps, treated door and window seals, and a sloped over-roof option to shed heavy rain â€” specified for Kolkata's monsoon as standard
Insulation: PUF panel or rock wool lining to handle heat and humidity
Anti-corrosion: Upgraded treatment for the humid, river-side environment
Flooring: Marine plywood, vinyl, or anti-skid steel
Electrical: Wiring, MCB board, LED lights, fan and AC points to your declared load
Windows: Sliding glass with MS safety grille; mesh ventilation
Doors: Container door retained for storage-office combos, or MS/glass entry door

Common sizes for Kolkata delivery:

SizeTypical use
10 ftGate security cabin or single-desk office
20 ftStandard site or yard office â€” most common
40 ftLarge office, or office + storage combination
20 ft + partitionOffice plus dispatch records room
40 ft modularJoined units for larger workspace

Custom layouts and partitions are built to your site footprint.

Customisation

Everything is built and fitted at our Greater Noida factory before dispatch â€” so the unit arrives complete, monsoon-sealed, and needs no on-site assembly.

  • Monsoon roof sealing and sloped over-roof
  • Upgraded anti-corrosion treatment for humid river-side sites
  • Internal partition walls for separate rooms
  • Air conditioner provision â€” cut-out, bracket, copper sleeve, drain
  • Full electrical fit-out with MCB, sockets, LED, fan points
  • Insulated false ceiling
  • Attached toilet module with FRP tank and plumbing
  • Pantry counter for longer-stay site offices
  • Exterior paint and company branding panel

Why Buy From SAMAN

We manufacture our own container offices â€” most suppliers serving Kolkata are dealers reselling units with no certification or warranty.

  • ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management (E20250218645)
  • ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management (E20250218646)
  • ISO 45001:2018 Occupational Health & Safety (E20250218647)
  • NSIC: NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207
  • DPIIT: DIPP56005
  • GST (North): 09ABBCS7101B1ZT

Structural frame warranty: 5 years. Finishing: 1–2 years. Engineered service life: 20–25 years. Over 500 projects since 2009.

Port, logistics, and industrial buyers who need vendor documentation for a procurement file or audit can request ISO certificate copies, NSIC registration, and GST papers with the order.

Price Factors

No fixed published price â€” every container office is built to specification. Cost depends on:

  • Converted shipping container vs new steel-frame build
  • Size (10 ft / 20 ft / 40 ft)
  • Monsoon-sealing and anti-corrosion level
  • Insulation and AC fit-out
  • Partition, toilet, and pantry additions

Freight from Greater Noida to Kolkata is quoted as a separate, transparent line item. For larger or multi-unit orders the per-unit freight is more efficient. Send your size and use for a written quotation with full breakup within 24 hours.

You can also see a shipping container office in standard 20 and 40 foot for port-yard conversions.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the price of a container office in Kolkata?

Price depends on size, whether it is a converted shipping container or a new steel-frame build, the monsoon-sealing and anti-corrosion level, the AC fit-out, and any partition or toilet additions. A basic 20 ft unit costs less than a 40 ft fully-fitted office. Freight from our Greater Noida factory is added as a separate transparent line. Call +91 87960 39938 for a written quotation with full breakup within 24 hours.

Can you deliver a container office to the Taratala belt or Kolkata Port area?

Yes. We deliver to the Taratala industrial corridor (PIN 700088), the Kolkata Port and Haldia dock area, the Dankuni logistics belt, the Howrah industrial zone, and all Kolkata addresses. For port and dock deliveries needing gate-pass or security authorisation, share the entry procedure when you order and we coordinate the delivery vehicle with your site.

Will the container office hold up through the Kolkata monsoon?

Yes. We seal the roof overlaps, treat the door and window seals, and offer a sloped over-roof to shed heavy rain â€” specified as standard for Kolkata-bound units. We also apply upgraded anti-corrosion treatment for the humid, river-side environment. The unit stays dry and structurally sound through the Bengal monsoon, and the steel is protected against humidity over its full service life.

Do you supply container offices for port and warehouse operations in Kolkata?

Yes. We supply dispatch supervisor cabins, gate security posts, and yard offices for port, dock, and warehouse operators across Kolkata, Haldia, and Dankuni. For operations that reconfigure their yard, the units are movable by crane or forklift. We can supply multiple units in a coordinated dispatch for a large logistics site.

Call or Send an Enquiry

For a container office in Kolkata â€” manufactured by SAMAN, sealed for the monsoon:

Call or WhatsApp. Same working day response. Include your size, use, and delivery zone for a complete quotation without a follow-up call.
